programme: Postimplementation focused follow-up after S01-S10; no new numbered stage

baseline_local_reproduction.scope: Controlled real shipped Manager protocol and Author gates, not live Pro/full deployed application

source_reconciliation: Current public main; no historical overlay. All newer/concurrent work must be preserved by publication gate.

limits: Per-store bounded cooperative writer lifetime; uninterruptible I/O can outlive awaiter.
Cancellation/response loss can race a complete publication; inspect inbox before any new import.
Cleanup failure is explicit; private orphan retirement requires offline ownership proof.
Supported JUnit dialect only; synthetic process receipt fixtures are not actual execution/client proof.
Bounded TTL/LRU advisory observations; reconnect/eviction/restart can establish a fresh first observation. No durable/cross-caller acknowledgment or authority.
Scoped principals cannot perform global qualification. No new grants; fixture support records never qualify a real client.
Historical restore preserves historical authority state and requires offline reconciliation before activation.
No keyed replay support or second journal selected. Inspect request/origin worker before deliberate repeat; Hub contract separate.

Actual ordinary-Pro/fresh-chat/bootstrap, deployed installed/loaded identity, vendor WAL-fix provenance, service-unit drain/activation, combined host capacity and physical durability remain external obligations.

specifications.scenario: Lost local dispatch reply after origin follow-up admission
specifications.required_result: Same deliberate dispatch recovers original identity; no new turn if retry support is implemented.
specifications.reason: Selected manual-only non-idempotent contract; no durable keyed dispatch recovery promised. Controlled actual-route effect loss invokes the inert effect once.

specifications.scenario: Changed response revision/content with same dispatch key
specifications.required_result: Conflict, not silent replacement.
specifications.reason: Local dispatch deliberately has no dispatch key. No changed-key replay contract added.

specifications.scenario: New deliberate dispatch with a new key
specifications.required_result: Allowed under current authority, not over-deduplicated.
specifications.reason: New deliberate dispatch remains available under current authority; there is no new-key parameter or automatic replay.

specifications.scenario: Busy worker and new-worker name conflict
specifications.required_result: Remain explicit outcomes; do not claim these alone prove idempotence.
specifications.reason: Existing busy/name-conflict semantics retained; these are refusal tests, not idempotence proof.

specifications.scenario: Local versus Hub replay paths
specifications.required_result: Record which boundary was actually exercised; no cross-surface guarantee inferred.
specifications.reason: Local inert route and Hub adapter tests remain separate. No local replay guarantee is inferred from Hub journaling.

specifications.scenario: New build on an existing Author home
specifications.required_result: Installed/loaded source and additive-index state are independently recorded.
specifications.reason: Offline wheel bytes/loaded identity and explicit additive indexes on disposable schema-1 state. No live home or deployment changed.
local_witnesses: offline installed wheel + disposable existing-home index verification

specifications.scenario: First actual ordinary-Pro write trial
specifications.required_result: Legitimate scoped authority and actual client witness; no self-certified write-supported assertion.
specifications.reason: Needs lawful exact ordinary-Pro account/client/model/route authority, metadata refresh and actual permitted observed write canary. No bypass or fabricated support record.

specifications.scenario: Fresh chat recovers already accepted work
specifications.required_result: Exact operations/candidates retained without replacement jobs or changed authority.
specifications.reason: Controlled HTTP/MCP recovery and exact operation/candidate/lease inverses are local evidence only. Exact client fresh-chat recovery requires authorized client witness.

specifications.scenario: Unsupported or unqualified write route
specifications.required_result: Keep that capability blocked; artifact/read-only alternatives remain honestly described.
specifications.reason: Unqualified role/profile/stale/corrupt route stays gated. Artifact/read-only alternatives retained; no ordinary-Pro acceptance inferred.

specifications.scenario: Service-unit maintenance and restore
specifications.required_result: Use supported drain/offline reconciliation; do not infer reboot/power-loss qualification.
specifications.reason: Disposable core restore and production-entrypoint old-schema rehearsal only. Real service drain/activation, deployment SQLite WAL provenance and physical durability remain operator obligations.

verification_scope: Exact actual results and retained intermediate failures are in POSTIMPLEMENTATION_RECEIPT.json; local repository mechanics only.
